title: Both reports' Sales Type filters work on a touch screen
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: Reports > Sales By Representative is open on a phone or tablet (a touch screen with no mouse pointer).
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Tap the Sales Type filter and untick "Part Sales".
  2. Open Reports > Sales By Customer, tap the Sales Type filter and untick "Service Sales".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the filter opens on tap and reads "Sales Type: Labor, Parts".
  • Step 2: the filter opens on tap and reads "Sales Type: Part Sales".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-R3: “With all three selected the filter reads "Sales Type: All". With none it reads "Sales Type: None". Otherwise it reads the selected names in option order, for example "Sales Type: Labor, Parts".”
  • S8-R8: “With both options selected, the filter reads "Sales Type: All Sales". With one, it reads that option's name, for example "Sales Type: Part Sales". With none, it reads "Sales Type: No sales".”

From: "SBR (Sales By Representative) Report" spec, Confluence 585629698, version 28 (12 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026

  • Sales By Representative spec, S17-R1: “All toolbar controls (â‹¯ exports, column selector, Show Unassigned toggle, date range picker, Sales Type, Invoice Status, Location) are visible and operable on touch.”

From: "SBC (Sales By Customer) Report" spec, Confluence 577634305, version 21 (6 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026

  • Sales By Customer spec, S21-R1: “Every toolbar control — date range, Sales Type, the Customer filter, location, the overflow menu, and the column selector — is visible and works on touch.”
